body:
Adds `research/module-entry`: how much routing mass a newly added module should get in a Hedge/LMSR router.

- Regret certificates obey a Kraft identity `Σ e^{-c_i} = 1`, so uniform entry `1/(n+1)` is the unique minimax rule.
- Prior-optimal shares `P_j/S_j` cost `H(P)`.
- The price of entry is exactly `ln(1/π)/η`, independent of the quality gap.
- 6 tests pass. Experiments are in `experiments/results.txt`. The white paper is in `paper/whitepaper.md`.
- Root README and portfolio page (`docs/index.html`) updated.
